spec.entry: close of the 5-minute resume bar inside 14:00-15:55 in the frame's own timezone (Asia/Tokyo for MNKD)
spec.initial_stop: chandelier on the resume bar alone: bar extreme -+ mult x ATR14 of the 5-MINUTE bars, mult=2.5
spec.ratchet: ON, but trails on DAILY ATR (extreme -+ mult x daily ATR) and is combined with max()/min() against the initial stop, so the tight initial stop normally binds
spec.arming: none - the stop is live from the first bar of the session after entry (engine day-boundary convention), unlike the live sleeve's armed stop
spec.gap_fill: fill at the bar open when a real >15-minute time break precedes the triggering bar AND that bar opened beyond the stop; otherwise fill at stop
spec.max_hold: 5 days; for a non-ET frame the exit is the FIRST BAR OF THE DAY
spec.gate: D-1 Calm, causal (RegimeLabels lag_days=1), presented to the signal as 'Normal'
